## Code of Conduct

Welcome to the repository for the Tekplace Pixel Bot! We're excited to have you here contributing to this project. To ensure a positive and inclusive environment for all contributors, we've established this Code of Conduct. Please take a moment to review and abide by these guidelines.

## Usage Guidelines

When using the Tekplace Pixel Bot, please keep the following guidelines in mind:

- **Responsible Use:** Utilize the bot responsibly and within the terms of service of Tekplace.
- **Warning:** Each pixel placement takes approximately 5 minutes. Larger images will take significantly longer. Use with patience and caution.
- **Disclaimer:** The developers are not liable for any misuse or unintended consequences of using this bot.

### Reporting Issues

If you encounter any violations of this Code of Conduct or have concerns about inappropriate behavior, harassment, or discrimination, please report it to the project maintainers immediately. All reports will be treated confidentially and investigated promptly.

### Conclusion

By participating in this project, you agree to uphold this Code of Conduct and contribute to creating a positive and inclusive community for all. Thank you for your cooperation and contributions!

*This Code of Conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.0, available at [https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct.html](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct.html)*.
